page_title: Clipboard Router — faster clipboard workflows for Mac

summary.name: Clipboard Router
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source clipboard manager for Apple-silicon Macs (macOS 14+) that offers searchable clipboard history, reviewed clipboard automations, Paste Stack, and an encrypted Vault for sensitive clips.
use_cases: search past copied text, links, images and files
queue several clips and paste them in order
keep secrets out of clipboard history
automate filing and follow-up notes from copied content
run text transforms like JSON pretty-print or case changes
share clips encrypted to a verified recipient key
summary.what_it_does: Clipboard Router captures clipboard history including text, URLs, RTF, HTML, images and file references, with search filters by content, app, type, date, folder and tag. Saved clips, notes, folders, tags and Smart Views let users keep and organize items. Paste Stack queues clips and copies them back in order, and deterministic transforms such as trimming whitespace, changing case or pretty-printing JSON are available. Reviewed Custom Actions can tag, file, create follow-up notes or open websites, optionally triggered by files entering a watched folder. Clipboard Health flags secret-like values, and Vault encrypts selected clips behind authentication.
notable: Free and open source, with a local workspace that needs no account, subscription or license key
Vault encrypts selected clips behind authentication and Clipboard Health detects secret-like values
Paste Stack queues clips and pastes them in order
Bundled cr command-line tool for analyze and transform pipelines
caveats: Version 0.1.0 requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later; no Intel or Mac App Store builds
iCloud sync, Salesforce/HubSpot connectors and hosted AI are engineering previews, not available in this release
Ordinary history and saved clips are not encrypted; other apps may read plaintext on the system pasteboard
On-device Assistant requires macOS 26 Macs with Apple Foundation Models
